description: Java class PcbMoveTool for manipulating PCB design files by moving graphical elements within the file.

classes.name: PcbMoveTool
classes.description: A utility class for reading, moving, and writing PCB design files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method to parse arguments and initiate move operation.

methods.name: readAndMove
methods.description: Reads a PCB file and applies move transformations.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Performs movement of various PCB elements within the node structure.

methods.name: moveStartEnd
methods.description: Moves start and end points of a segment.

methods.name: moveAt
methods.description: Moves the 'at' coordinate of a module.

methods.name: moveCoordinatesInFirstChildren
methods.description: Moves coordinates in the first child node.

methods.name: moveCoordinates
methods.description: Adjusts coordinate values by dx and dy.
